subject: OrbitAI onboarding — handoff playbook, owners, and kickoff plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@orbitai.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi@orbitai.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Aug 2028 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: OrbitAI onboarding — handoff playbook, owners, and kickoff plan

Team —

Great news: OrbitAI signed yesterday and legal sent the counters for signature. Their go-live target is Sept 15 (data integration window Aug 14–31). I'm proposing a compact handoff so CS has a clear owner list, pre-kick checklist, and a targeted kickoff next week. Key deal context below and attached files include the SOW draft, network diagram they provided, and the Mutual Action Plan (MAP).

Deal snapshot (high level):
- ARR: $480k annual; committed to Redwood Dedicated (2x GPU pool), plus 50k API usage credits for first 90 days.
- Primary use case: low-latency customer support embeddings + live summarization for agents.
- Data: Ingest from Postgres + S3; will route sensitive PII through VPC Private deployment (they requested HSM key integration).
- Success metric: 85% reduction in mean handling time for chat, <250ms median token latency for support models.

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation (proposed assignments):
1) PM & technical lead: Marissa Cole — overall rollout owner, kickoff facilitator, verification owner for latency SLOs.
2) Infra lead: Karthik Iyer — network/VPC, KMS/HSM integration, firewall/egress requirements.
3) Sales support (me) — onboarding coordination, billing handover, and escalation buffer for first 30 days.

Target dates:
- Internal kickoff (prep only): Aug 3, 10:00–11:00 PT (internal attendees only)
- Customer kickoff (with OrbitAI): Aug 8, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Data ingestion window begins: Aug 14
- Go-live: Sept 15

Risks / known blockers:
- Legal asked for a small redline around data residency and audit logs — I've attached the redline doc; legal team is on standby.
- OrbitAI engineering flagged this unusual NAT configuration for their cloud carrier (see network-diagram attachment).

Please confirm you can own the items above or propose alternates. If we're aligned I'll send the internal kickoff invite and include the OrbitAI tech contacts.

Attachments: OrbitAI_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), orbitai-network-diagram.png, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@orbitai.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi@orbitai.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Aug 2028 17:06:00 +0000
Subject: Re: OrbitAI onboarding — handoff playbook, owners, and kickoff plan

Thanks Jordan — congrats team. I can take PM ownership and will run the kickoff and the post-kick acceptance checklist. A couple of clarifying Qs before I schedule invites: 

1) Environment topology: is the plan to run their embedding pipeline on Dedicated in us-west while routing PII data to a Private VPC? Karthik, can you confirm feasibility of the hybrid routing and expected time to get KMS integrated if HSM is required?

2) Acceptance criteria: Jordan, can you paste the exact KPIs we agreed with Sophie so we have them in the MAP? I'll add a short QA suite we can run during staging to measure MHT and token latency.

3) On attachments: I reviewed the SOW draft — section 3.2 still references a monthly SLA credit that legal asked to clarify. I'll loop Legal if needed, but let me know if Sales has guidance on acceptable SLA language.

Proposed immediate actions (I'll own and update the MAP):
- Marissa: send internal kickoff invite (Aug 3) and an agenda.
- Karthik: validate HSM/KMS approach and list required firewall rules by Aug 2 EOD.
- Jordan: confirm OrbitAI's primary tech contact for ingestion (Sophie or Ravi?) and supply sandbox creds after the kickoff.

I'll hold off on the external invite until Karthik confirms the network items — want to avoid scheduling extra meetings.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
m: +1 415-555-0194

From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@orbitai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi@orbitai.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Aug 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitAI onboarding — handoff playbook, owners, and kickoff plan

Marissa / Jordan — thanks and excited to get started. Quick answers: 
- Primary tech contact for ingestion is Ravi (ravi@orbitai.com). I'll be on the kickoff but Ravi will own the data plumbing.
- HSM / KMS: we need to use our existing AWS KMS key (customer-managed). We don't need a separate on-prem HSM, but the traffic must stay inside our VPC for tokenization step.
- KPIs: agreed on 85% reduction in MHT and <250ms median token latency; also want 95th percentile latency <450ms for agent workflows.

Attached is a one-page summary of their compliance checklist (we can walk through on the kickoff). We can join Aug 8 for the external kickoff but happy to do an internal pre-kick the week of Aug 3 if it helps.

Attachments: OrbitAI_Compliance_Summary.pdf

Sophie Lane
Head of Integrations | OrbitAI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@orbitai.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi@orbitai.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 11:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: OrbitAI onboarding — handoff playbook, owners, and kickoff plan

Quick update from infra: I validated the hybrid routing plan. Notes: 
- We can host embeddings on Dedicated in us-west and route PII collection through a Private VPC peering to OrbitAI. KMS integration with their customer-managed AWS KMS is supported; I'll need their KMS ARN and a cross-account IAM role to finish the setup.
- Firewall: we require outbound TLS to the following CIDR ranges and the Agent IP allowlist in the MAP (I'll add exact IPs in the MAP by EOD Aug 2).
- Timeline: with the IAM/KMS info + sandbox credentials we can complete network/KMS setup in ~5 business days. That keeps us on track for the Aug 14 ingestion window if OrbitAI provides creds by Aug 6.

I'll update the MAP and upload the ip/egress checklist to the HubSpot deal link. Marissa, feel free to schedule the internal kickoff — I'll be on the call and bring the network checklist.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
